summary: Three children (ages 9, 6, and 6) from a Denver-area family camping near the Midland Bike Trail east of Buena Vista wandered off around 9:00 AM on September 26, 2026 and were reported missing after family searched for two hours. Sheriff's deputies, Chaffee County Search and Rescue foot teams, drones, a helicopter and K9 Arch conducted a grid search and visually located the children about 1.5 miles from camp at approximately 2:00 PM; they were uninjured and in good health.
location: Midland Bike Trail, east of Buena Vista
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office / Chaffee County Search and Rescue
notes: Children lost ~5 hours (wandered off ~9:00 AM, located ~2:00 PM); multi-agency grid search with drones, helicopter, K9 Arch and foot teams. Source: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office Facebook page.
